library_intro: Pick a conversation to practise. You can talk or type. When you finish, you'll get feedback on how you did.
no_scenarios: No scenarios in this category yet.
couldnt_hear: Couldn't make that out. Try again a little closer to the microphone, or type.
message_hint: Press Enter to send, Shift and Enter for a new line.
handsfree_help: Just talk. When you pause, your turn is sent automatically, and {name} answers out loud. Headphones work best.
mic_denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in your browser's site settings, or type instead.
mic_unsupported: This browser can't record audio. Please type instead.
voice_unavailable: Voice isn't available right now, so replies will be text only.
status_recording: Recording. Press Stop and send when you're done.
model_error: The AI is busy or unreachable right now. Please wait a moment and try again.
session_expired: This practice session has expired. Please start again.
turn_limit: You've reached the message limit for this session. End it to get feedback.
message_too_long: That message is too long. Please keep it under {n} characters.
recording_too_long: That recording is too long. Please keep it under two minutes.
criteria: How you did on each point
left_on_table_help: The difference between your result and the best the other side would have accepted.
builder_intro: Describe a conversation for students to practise. Fields marked required must be filled in. Write in the language students will use.
draft_label: Describe the scenario in a sentence or two
draft_hint: For example: a student asks their manager for a deadline extension on a big report.
drafting: Drafting… this takes a few seconds.
drafted: Draft ready. Check every field and edit anything that isn't right before saving.
draft_failed: Couldn't draft that right now. Try again, or fill in the form yourself.
section_hidden_help: Students never see this section. It shapes how the character behaves and how students are graded.
f_brief_hint: What the student is told before starting: who they are, who they're meeting, what they want. Include any numbers they need.
f_goal_hint: Used for grading. What would a strong student do or achieve?
f_role_hint: Job title and organisation. Use a fictional organisation.
f_persona_hint: How they act, what they care about, how they react to different approaches.
f_private: What they know but won't say
f_private_hint: Information the student has to discover by asking good questions.
f_reveal_hint: Optional. Explain what the character was hiding.
f_offer_enable: The two sides negotiate over a number, like a price or salary
f_offer_help: The character states its position every turn, and the app enforces these limits in code, so students can't talk it past them.
f_offer_step: Biggest move allowed in one reply
f_offer_mult_hint: For example: 1200 for 1,200 kg, or 12 for 12 months
err_rubric: Add between 2 and 8 grading criteria, one per line.
builder_note: In a real deployment, only signed-in faculty could create or edit scenarios.
insights_intro: Anonymous data. No student messages are stored: only counts, scores, timings and costs.
no_data: No data yet. Complete a practice session first.
